optimized_decoder.persistent_weight_capacity_proof: The fused path retains unpacked BF16 packed-projection sources plus its packed BF16 tensor. OptimizedDecoder releases the unused sources and keeps two phase-specific BFP4 packed tensors; two BFP4 copies require fewer bytes than the packed-plus-unpacked BF16 fused baseline. MLP and output projections likewise replace one BF16 copy with two BFP4 copies. Persistent material-weight storage therefore does not increase.
